clauses.text: next_time_ask feedback always records the delegation layer, corrected feedback requires a target layer, and accepted or reverted feedback carries none.
Feedback records written before target_layer existed remain readable.
The feedback summary counts each decision once by its latest feedback, by status and by target layer, counting corrections without a layer as unrecorded.
The review form asks what a correction changes only for corrections and refuses to save a correction without it; the card and history show the layer.
